articles.author: Sammy Westfall
articles.title: State Dept. apologizing for Africa map that mislabeled every country - The Washington Post
articles.description: The map, part of a presentation Sunday at the AIDS 2026 summit in Rio de Janeiro, purports to show six African countries that are receiving U.S. health funding. It gets each of them wrong.
articles.content:
The U.S. delegation at a global AIDS conference displayed a map of Africa thats so wrong the State Department has been issuing apologies.
